cohort: 11,323 women giving birth, including 1,479 with prior cesarean section
finding: This study found a high incidence of uterine rupture (0.35% overall, 1.69% in women with prior cesarean section), with major risk factors being unbooked status, injudicious oxytocin use, and unjustified TOLAC, leading to high rates of perinatal mortality (85%).
